lead.zh: 沿运行、监控、权限、故障与退役读十四个主题。先建立排查顺序，再用具体服务的配置与日志验证。
lead.en: Study fourteen topics covering runtime, monitoring, permissions, failure and retirement. Form an investigation order, then validate it against a service’s configuration and logs.

zh: 说出首字延迟和吞吐各自受什么影响，各给一个优化手段
给线上服务列出三件必须监控的事，并说明各自先查什么
供应商宣布模型退役时，能走一遍迁移评估的四个检查项
en: Say what drives time-to-first-token and throughput respectively, with one optimization for each
List three things a live service must monitor, and what to check first for each
When a vendor announces retirement, walk through the four migration-assessment checks

answers.zh: 首字延迟影响开始等待的时间，吞吐影响连续生成或并发能力。前者可先查输入处理与排队，后者可查批处理与硬件瓶颈；需用相同负载验证。
answers.en: Time to first token affects initial waiting; throughput affects generation/concurrency capacity. Investigate input processing and queues for the former, batching and hardware limits for the latter under equal load.

answers.zh: 先看任务完成率、延迟分布、错误、用量和权限异常。成本突增时对照请求数、输入长度、重试和工具调用记录，不立即归因于模型单价。
answers.en: Track completion, latency distribution, errors, usage and permission anomalies. For a cost spike, compare request count, input lengths, retries and tool calls before blaming the model rate.

answers.zh: 至少覆盖接口与流式、任务质量、工具与权限、成本与延迟，并核对数据条款和回滚。先在代表性请求上对比，达到预先约定的条件再切换。
answers.en: Cover interface/streaming, task quality, tools/permissions and cost/latency, plus data terms and rollback. Compare representative requests before switching against agreed criteria.

nextTask.zh: 从容量预算走到运行检查
nextTask.en: Move from a capacity budget to runtime checks
